pages.name: Colle: 5.c3 Nc6
pages.notes: Plan 2 named White's e4 in a Black plan; plan 4 rerouted knights from e1, where none stands. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; overview no longer writes the triangle as a route; notation and British spelling.

pages.name: Colle: 5.c3 Nc6 6.Nbd2 Bd6
pages.notes: Plan 2 sent the d2-knight via f1 to e3 or g3, not a Colle idea; plan 3 named ...dxe4 before White's e4; plan 4 gave a ...a5-a4 route. Rewrote plans 2-4 (plan 3 revised once more after a later reviewer showed ...Qc7 cannot eye e5 through the d6-bishop; re-accepted). British spelling.

pages.name: Colle: 5.c3 Nc6 6.Nbd2 Bd6 7.O-O O-O
pages.notes: Plan 2 routed the d2-knight through f1, where the rook now stands; plan 4 pushed ...b5 into the d3-bishop. Rewrote plans 2 and 4. Plan 3 ("exchanging on d4 (dxc4)") is wrong, but two rewrites were rejected (...b6/...Bb7 cannot cover e4 or e5 here, and ...Qc7 cannot see e5 through the d6-bishop), so the old text is kept and its references are in the skips. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Colle: 5.c3 Nc6 6.Nbd2 Bd6 7.O-O O-O 8.dxc5 Bxc5
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 said e4 activates the d3-bishop; it frees the c1-bishop. Plan 2 named White's e4 in a Black plan. British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn Game: Zukertort Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed the b1-knight via f1-g3 although it is on d2; plan 4 called for a minority attack with no such structure; plan 1 omitted Bd3. British spelling.

pages.name: Alekhine Defense, QGD
pages.notes: Plan 2 (White) named Black's Bg7. British spelling throughout, including Alekhine Defence.

pages.name: QGD: Marshall Defence, 3.cxd5 Nxd5 4.e4
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote Be2/d3 and 0-0; plan 2 fianchettoed ...b7 to hit e4 instead of the line's ...e5 and ...c5 strikes. British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Baltic Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 named Qb3 in a Black plan; plan 2 said Qb3 attacks the f5-bishop; plan 3 garbled 3.cxd5 Bxb1; plan 4 invented a loosened kingside. Rewrote all plans; British spelling (Baltic Defence).

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Baltic Defense, Pseudo-Chigorin
pages.notes: Plan 1 said Qb3 challenges the f5-bishop; plan 2 rerouted a knight to e5 via ...Ne4; plan 3 named a central pawn majority that does not exist; plan 4 gave ...c5 with the knight on c6. Rewrote all plans; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD: Chigorin, 3.Nf3 Bg4 4.e3
pages.notes: Overview said 4.e3 unpins the knight, when it creates the pin to d1; plan 1 gave Rc1 with b1 and c1 still occupied; plan 4 sent the c6-knight to e7 (first rewrite rejected for a false ...Nf6 claim; fixed to ...e6 and ...Nge7 and re-accepted). British spelling.
